rows.definition: The nested linear_attn_config object inside text_config of the HF config.json of GLM-5.3-Flash (glm5_next) and Kimi-K3.1-Pro checkpoints, carrying the KDA linear-attention geometry num_heads, head_dim, short_conv_kernel_size and gate_lower_bound. model.Config.UnmarshalJSON (internal/model/config.go) decodes it through glm5LinearAttnConfigJSON and folds it at parse time onto the flat axes LinearNumKeyHeads, LinearNumValueHeads, LinearKeyHeadDim, LinearValueHeadDim, LinearConvKernelDim and LinearGateLowerBound so the native forward reads one surface. glm5NextIdentity (internal/model/glm5next_spine.go) carries the same object as its LinearAttn field and pins it to 64 heads, head dim 128 and conv kernel 4 for checkpoint admission.
rows.distinction: It is the container config block, not any of the fields it carries: gate_lower_bound (row kimik31-l1-gatelowerbound) and short_conv_kernel_size (row gwengine-short-conv-kernel-size) are scalars inside it. GatedDeltaNet (row guardgate-gateddeltanet) is the layer family whose geometry the block describes, not the block itself.

rows.definition: The short_conv_kernel_size field of the linear_attn_config object in the HF config.json of GLM-5.3-Flash and Kimi-K3.1-Pro checkpoints: the width of the causal depthwise conv1d applied per q/k/v stream in each KDA linear-attention layer. Go parses it as ShortConvKernelSize (internal/model/config.go, internal/model/glm5next_spine.go) and folds it into model.Config.LinearConvKernelDim; on the GGUF path the same axis arrives as the ssm.conv_kernel header key (internal/ggufload/gguf_config.go), and isExactGLM5NextConfig pins it to 4.
rows.distinction: A scalar conv-width config value, not a compute kernel: matKernel (row x-gateway-engine-matkernel) and glmDsaMatKernel (row x2-gateway-engine-glmdsamatkernel) select GEMM arithmetic, while this value sizes the KDA conv filters and their history state. It lives inside the linear_attn_config block (row attn-linear-attn-config), which is the container, not the width.
